profile.name: Behnam Sepehri
profile.title: Full-Stack Developer
profile.bioShort: Full-Stack Developer with over 4 years of experience in building responsive, scalable web applications.
bioLong: Full-Stack Developer with over 4 years of experience in building responsive, scalable web applications. I specialize in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with a strong focus on UI/UX, performance, and maintainability.

My journey began with WordPress and WebGL development, evolving into advanced front-end engineering. Currently, I'm enhancing my skills in Docker and CI/CD pipelines, preparing for senior-level roles.

projects.name: DeskFolio
projects.description: A portfolio that boots instead of scrolls; a macOS desktop rebuilt in React, where each section of my CV is an app you open.

projects.name: NestFreund - Modern Housing Support Platform
projects.description: A platform empowering individuals at risk of losing their homes with AI-driven technology.

projects.name: Movie Explorer - A Movie Search App
projects.description: A movie search app that allows users to search for movies, view details, and save their favorites.

projects.name: Calendar Clone - Modern React Calendar App
projects.description: Modern Calendar App - A responsive React calendar with event management, multiple view modes, and mobile-optimized interface built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

projects.name: AgriFlow Document Hub
projects.description: A modern, responsive document management system for agricultural logistics companies. Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

projects.name: Patient management system
projects.description: A modern, full-stack healthcare patient management system. The application provides a comprehensive solution for managing patient information, appointments, and healthcare workflows.

projects.name: Nike E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A fully responsive, modern e-commerce platform built with Next.js 15, React, and TypeScript, featuring a stunning 3D hero section with Three.js, dynamic product catalog, shopping cart functionality, and seamless user authentication.

projects.name: Tome Talk
projects.description: A full-stack AI web app that turns any PDF into something you can have a real conversation with. Upload a book and it's parsed in the browser, split into indexed segments, and stored alongside an auto-generated cover. From there you pick a voice persona and speak to it.
